urls.title: Image URLs
urls.description: Direct links to JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, HEIC or SVG images, one per line. Apify key-value store record URLs are read with your token. Social-network links and private or internal addresses are refused. Leave every image source empty to convert a generated 640x480 test image. Failed images are free.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional alternative to Image URLs, in Apify's request-list format (e.g. a file with one URL per line). Combined with Image URLs.

keyValueStoreRecords.title: Key-value store records
keyValueStoreRecords.description: Images uploaded to an Apify key-value store, as storeId/recordKey or username~store-name/recordKey, one per line. Use this to convert your own files without hosting them anywhere.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID
datasetId.description: Optional: convert the image URLs in another run's dataset (e.g. a product scraper's output). Dataset ID or username~dataset-name.

imageField.title: Dataset image field
imageField.description: The dataset field that holds the image URL: a string, an array of URLs, or objects with a url/src. Dot paths like product.image work.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: WebP: small files, transparency, best support. AVIF: smallest files, slower to encode. JPEG: works everywhere, no transparency (flattened onto white). PNG: lossless, large files.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: 1-100 for WebP, AVIF and JPEG. 80 is a good balance; 90+ for near-lossless. PNG is lossless and ignores it. With a target size, this is the highest quality tried.

targetKb.title: Target file size (KB)
targetKb.description: Optional: the actor picks the highest quality whose file fits this size (PNG is reduced to a 256-colour palette if lossless is too big). If even quality 1 doesn't fit, you get the smallest file with a warning. Leave empty for fixed quality.

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Optional: shrink images wider than this. Images are never enlarged.

maxHeight.title: Max height (px)
maxHeight.description: Optional: shrink images taller than this. Images are never enlarged.

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: With both max width and height: inside keeps the aspect ratio within the box; cover crops to fill the box; contain pads to the box (transparent, or white for JPEG); fill stretches; outside covers the box without cropping.

stripMetadata.title: Strip metadata
stripMetadata.description: Remove EXIF (camera, GPS location), XMP and ICC data; colours are converted to sRGB and the EXIF rotation is applied first. Turn off to keep the metadata.

maxInputMegapixels.title: Max input size (megapixels)
maxInputMegapixels.description: Larger images are skipped with a free error item (at most 100). Images over 12 MP cost $0.004 instead of $0.002, so 12 caps the price per image.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger downloads are skipped with a free error item.

timeoutSecs.title: Download timeout (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Max time to download one image.
